shots.title: The Very Long Script
shots.caption: First, write the whole movie.
shots.narration: The director begins by typing a very long script with every scene written out.
shots.startKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Subject: Character A, the indie director, sits at the studio desk facing a typewriter. Action: he rests his hands near the keys, ready to type. Location/context: night studio desk with a blank page loaded in the typewriter, coffee mug, and warm desk lamp. Composition: medium eye-level shot, typewriter and director's hands clearly visible. Style: cinematic warm desk light, cool blue background monitor glow, shallow depth of field.
shots.endKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Starting from the same typewriter desk scene, change the blank page into a very long paper script pouring from the typewriter, crossing the desk, and spilling onto the floor. Character A looks satisfied. Keep the same camera angle, coffee mug, lamp, warm desk light, cool monitor glow, and shallow depth of field.
shots.videoPrompt: Use a locked-off medium shot of Character A at the typewriter. His fingers type while the typewriter advances. The paper script grows longer across the desk. By the end, the script spills onto the floor and Character A pauses with a satisfied look.

shots.title: LeonardoAI Magic Box
shots.caption: Script in. Notecards out.
shots.narration: Next, he feeds the long script into a magic box labeled LEONARDOAI, and it prints a stack of shot notecards.
shots.startKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Subject: Character A holds the long typed script in both hands beside a small glowing magic box. Action: he is about to feed the script into the box. Location/context: studio desk at night. The box has one large readable label with exact text "LEONARDOAI" in bold black sans-serif letters. Composition: medium close shot, director's hands, script, and box label all clear. Style: cinematic practical light, warm glow from the box, shallow depth of field.
shots.endKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Starting from the same desk and glowing "LEONARDOAI" box, change the scene so the long script feeds into one side and paper notecards come out the other side. Add a neat notecard pile with readable text "shot 01", "shot 02", "shot 03" in simple black marker. Keep close framing, warm box glow, and crisp paper texture.
shots.videoPrompt: Use a locked-off insert shot on Character A's hands, the long script, and the LEONARDOAI box. Character A guides the script into the box. The box glows brighter, then notecards print out one by one and slide into a growing pile.

shots.title: Notecards To Storyboards
shots.caption: Notecards become storyboards.
shots.narration: The robotic clones read the printed notecards and draw simple storyboards for each shot.
shots.startKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Subject: Character A stands at the main studio desk with several Character B robotic clones nearby. Action: Character A holds out printed notecards as assignments. Location/context: night studio with the glowing box labeled "LEONARDOAI" and a pile of notecards on the desk. Composition: wide eye-level shot showing the human director, robotic clones, box, and desk clearly. Style: cinematic warm and cool mixed lighting, shallow depth of field, physical paper props.
shots.endKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Starting from the workstation background, change the scene so five Character B robotic clones sit at five separate desks drawing storyboard panels from printed notecards while the glowing LEONARDOAI box remains visible on the main desk area. Character A watches from the center. Show simple hand-drawn storyboard boxes on each sheet. Keep the wide view, warm desk lamps, blue monitor glow, and paper-pencil texture.
shots.videoPrompt: Use a mostly locked-off wide shot in the workstation set. Character A hands printed notecards to the Character B robotic clones. The robots move to nearby desks within the same set, read the notecards, pick up pencils, and draw simple storyboard panels. End with all five robotic clones drawing at the same time.

shots.title: Create Keyframes
shots.caption: Every shot gets a beginning and ending.
shots.narration: The robotic clones use the storyboard drawings to build a matching start frame, end frame, and motion cue.
shots.startKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Subject: one Character B robotic clone sits at a desk studying a printed notecard and a finished storyboard drawing. Action: the robot clone prepares to create keyframe cards. Location/context: night studio workstation with pencil, paper, and two blank cards. Render exact readable labels "start" and "end" on the two blank cards in simple black marker. Composition: medium close shot over the desk, robot face and paper layout visible. Style: cinematic warm desk light, shallow depth of field, crisp paper texture.
shots.endKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Starting from the same robot workstation, change the blank cards into a completed start frame card and completed end frame card beside the storyboard drawing. Render exact readable labels "start", "end", and "motion"; place the "motion" arrow card between start and end. Keep a clean close overhead layout, warm desk light, and realistic paper texture.
shots.videoPrompt: Use a steady over-the-shoulder insert on one Character B robotic clone's desk. The robot studies the storyboard drawing, draws the start frame card, draws the end frame card, then places the motion arrow between them.

shots.title: Completed Clips Return
shots.caption: Completed clips return.
shots.narration: The robotic clones come back with completed clips for every storyboard shot.
shots.startKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Subject: Character A waits at the main studio desk while Character B robotic clones return from their workstations. Action: the robot clones carry completed clip cards, storyboard sheets, and start/end frame cards. Location/context: same night studio with corkboard, monitors, and desk lamp visible. Composition: wide eye-level shot with the main desk centered and robotic clones entering from different sides. Style: cinematic warm and cool mixed lighting, shallow depth of field, physical paper props.
shots.endKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Starting from the same assembly desk, change the returned materials into a clean ordered row of completed clip cards. Character A points at the sequence. Render readable labels from "shot 01" through "shot 10" in simple black marker. Keep the overhead view, warm desk light, realistic paper texture, and crisp readable text.
shots.videoPrompt: Use a locked-off wide shot of the assembly desk. Character B robotic clones return into frame carrying completed cards. One by one, the robots place completed clip cards on the desk in order from shot 01 to shot 10. Character A checks the row and nods.

shots.title: Assemble Final Movie
shots.caption: Assemble one final movie.
shots.narration: Together, the director and robotic clones combine every clip into one final output.
shots.startKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Subject: Character A and the Character B robotic clones gather around the same glowing LEONARDOAI box on the desk. Action: they prepare to feed the ordered clip cards into the box for final assembly. Location/context: night studio main desk with the clip cards in a neat row. Composition: medium wide eye-level shot, human director, robot faces, and LEONARDOAI box visible. Style: cinematic warm desk light, blue monitor glow, realistic paper textures.
shots.endKeyframePrompt: Generate a realistic keyframe image. Starting from the same LEONARDOAI box assembly scene, change the box output so one continuous finished film strip emerges. Character A and the Character B robotic clones lean in and smile at the result. Keep the same night studio desk, warm practical light, shallow depth of field, and crisp film strip texture.
shots.videoPrompt: Use a locked-off medium insert on the LEONARDOAI box and the team's hands. Character A points to the ordered clip cards while one robotic clone feeds the first card into the box. Other robotic clones guide the cards. The LEONARDOAI box glows and one continuous film strip emerges.

shots.narration: At the end, the director and robotic clones watch the finished movie and clap together.
